metadata.title: Tommy Tremble Faces Stiff Challenge in Week 8
metadata.description: Carolina tight end Tommy Tremble has provided a bit of fantasy value this season, but his Week 8 test against Green Bay on Thursday will be a tough challenge. The Packers' defense has slowed tight ends all season, and with Tremble already sharing snaps and production with fellow tight end Darren Waller, that doesn't leave Tremble with a very good outlook. Tremble had just one catch for eight yards across two targets in Week 7 against Tampa Bay. In the three games before that, the TE had four targets in each contest, but 41, 12 and 46 yards - he scored his lone two touchdowns of the season in Week 6. After Waller and especially wide receivers Tetairoa McMillan and Jalen Coker, there's not a lot of production available for Tremble in the passing game. He sits as TE32 in our RotoBaller Week 8 projections, so he's just a starting option in deeper fantasy setups.

metadata.title: Tommy Tremble - Unproductive in loss Sunday
metadata.description: Tremble hauled in one catch for eight yards during Sunday's 43-13 loss to the Buccaneers.
metadata.analysis: Tremble had two touchdowns in the 25-14 win over the Eagles in Week 6. However, it was a different story in Week 7, with the 26-year-old catching just one pass for the second time this season. While Tremble could find the end zone again at some point moving forward, he likely won't be consistent enough to be considered anything other than a desperation fantasy option, especially while Darren Waller is on the field.

metadata.title: Tommy Tremble a Deep-League Option Only in Week 7
metadata.description: Carolina Panthers tight end Tommy Tremble has some deep-league appeal as his team faces a struggling Tampa Bay Buccaneers defense in Week 7. Panthers quarterback Bryce Young has favored wide receivers Tetairoa McMillan and Jalen Coker with his targets early in the season. However, Tremble caught all four of his targets and had two touchdowns in a 25-14 Week 6 win against the Philadelphia Eagles. Tampa Bay is allowing 224 passing yards per game this season, which can allow Young to air the ball out to multiple targets on Sunday. Tremble hasn't shown consistent production for redraft leagues, but he offers value in deeper formats with multiple TE spots to fill.

metadata.title: Tommy Tremble a Waiver-Wire Pickup After Two-Touchdown Game?
metadata.description: Carolina Panthers tight end Tommy Tremble caught all four of his targets for the second straight week for 46 yards and his first two touchdowns of the season on Sunday in the 25-14 win over the hosting Philadelphia Eagles in Week 6. The 26-year-old played 68% of the offensive snaps, more than both Mitchell Evans and Darren Waller, coming out of the Week 5 bye, and he now has exactly four targets in each of the last three games. The Panthers' offense has looked much better early on this year, but Tremble still is not getting the type of volume that fantasy managers should really be chasing on the waiver wire, outside of deep two-TE leagues. Tremble has never proven to be much of a fantasy-relevant tight end in his five-plus years in the NFL, never going over 27 catches, 249 yards, or three touchdowns in a single season. He has 15 catches on 19 targets through five games in 2026 for 128 yards and two scores. Waller did not have a single reception against the Eagles, but he should still be considered the team's best red-zone weapon at the TE position as long as he is healthy.

metadata.title: Tommy Tremble scores pair of TDs in Week 6
metadata.description: Carolina Panthers tight end Tommy Tremble caught two touchdowns on four targets in a 25-14 Week 6 win.
metadata.analysis: Tremble had four receptions for 46 yards and now has 4+ targets in every game this season except one. He also has 40+ yards in two games and caught the first two touchdowns of his season.

metadata.title: Tommy Tremble - Two TDs in win over Philly
metadata.description: Tremble caught all four targets for 46 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 25-14 win over the Eagles.
metadata.analysis: Tremble played 54 snaps to Mitchell Evans' 43 and Darren Waller's 36, and Tremble ran the most routes of the trio. His touchdowns were both of the red-zone variety, as he scored from 12 and 19 yards out. The tight end entered Sunday with 11 catches for 82 yards on 15 targets, so he's not worth chasing in fantasy ahead of next Sunday's date with the Bucs.

metadata.title: Tommy Tremble Scores Twice in Victory Over Eagles
metadata.description: Carolina Panthers tight end Tommy Tremble recorded four receptions (on four targets) for 46 yards (11.5 yards per catch) and two touchdowns in a 25-14 win over the Philadelphia Eagles. Tremble led Carolina's tight ends in offensive snaps played Sunday with 54. The pair of touchdowns marked the first scores for Tremble on the 2026 campaign, while the 46 yards set a new season-high and the four receptions tied his season-high number. Tremble was much more productive than fellow tight end Darren Waller, who saw just two targets in the passing game and did not record a statistic against the Eagles. Tremble is currently owned in 0% of Yahoo leagues and will likely be a popular waiver wire pickup or streaming option for a Week 7 matchup with the Tampa Bay Buccaneers.

metadata.title: Tommy Tremble - Ready for Sunday
metadata.description: Tremble (ribs) has no injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Eagles.
metadata.analysis: Tremble upgraded to a full participant in Friday's practice after opening Week 6 prep as a limited participant. The tight end is all set to suit up for the Panthers' showdown with the Eagles on Sunday.

metadata.title: Tommy Tremble (rib) listed as limited Thursday
metadata.description: Tommy Tremble (rib) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
metadata.analysis: The veteran was able to practice on Thursday, though he remained limited again due to the rib issue that he's managing. He could be sidelined in Week 6, and if he is, fantasy managers should expect Darren Waller (toe) to play more snaps in a matchup against the Eagles.

metadata.title: Tommy Tremble (ribs) practices Thursday
metadata.description: Tommy Tremble practiced again on Thursday.
metadata.analysis: Tremble remains off the fantasy radar.

metadata.title: Tommy Tremble - Nursing rib injury
metadata.description: Tremble (ribs) was a limited participant at practice Wednesday.
metadata.analysis: Tremble played a reduced role at tight end in Week 4 versus Detroit before the Panthers' bye in Week 5, and it seems plausible that whatever rib injury he's dealing with now could also have been the reason for that. In any case, he'll probably have to practice in full Thursday or Friday to avoid carrying an injury designation into the weekend.

metadata.title: Tommy Tremble (ribs) limited Wednesday
metadata.description: Tommy Tremble (ribs) was a limited participant on Wednesday.
metadata.analysis: Tremble was left limited at Wednesday's practice due to an injury to his ribs that he's dealing with. If it leaves him sidelined in Week 6, look for Darren Waller (toe) to see more work as a result of his absence.

metadata.title: Tommy Tremble not practicing Tuesday
metadata.description: Tommy Tremble was not practicing on Tuesday.
metadata.analysis: Tremble did not have his jersey on during practice to open the week off the Panthers bye. His status will need to be monitored in practice the next few days.

metadata.title: Tommy Tremble - Four catches in SNF win
metadata.description: Tremble caught all four targets for 12 yards in Sunday night's win over the Lions.
metadata.analysis: Involved in a three-man committee at tight end, Tremble's 38 snaps trailed both Mitchell Evans (46) and Darren Waller (40) at the position. He also ran fewer routes than both. Tremble's 11 grabs this season have produced 82 scoreless yards on 15 targets. He has no fantasy appeal.

metadata.title: Tommy Tremble hauls in four passes in Week 4
metadata.description: Tommy Tremble secured all four of his targets, but for just 12 yards in Sunday's 32-26 win over the Lions.
metadata.analysis: Tremble was not able to do much with his four receptions in Sunday's win, but it is worth noting his involvement in the passing game for the second straight week. Tremble has now caught 7 of 8 targets for 53 yards over the last two games.

metadata.title: Tommy Tremble - Three catches in loss
metadata.description: Tremble caught three of his five targets for 25 yards in Sunday's 59-37 loss to the Bears.
metadata.analysis: Tremble played 34 offensive snaps, which ended up being just under 56 percent of the Panthers' total offensive plays. The tight end also contributed 11 special teams snaps in the losing effort, showing some versatility in what was overall a productive offensive day for the Panthers.

metadata.title: Tommy Tremble catches three passes in Week 1
metadata.description: Tommy Tremble caught three of his five targets for 25 yards in the Panthers' 59-37 loss to the Chicago Bears in Week 1.
metadata.analysis: Tremble made the most of his modest target share, finishing third on the team as part of an offense that saw quarterback Bryce Young spread the ball around to seven different receivers. The tight end remains a risky option in all formats ahead of a Week 2 contest against the Atlanta Falcons.

metadata.title: Tommy Tremble - Logs two catches in preseason win
metadata.description: Tremble caught both of his targets for 20 yards during the Panthers' 34-17 win over the Jaguars in Friday's preseason game.
metadata.analysis: Tremble was listed as the Panthers' starting tight end Friday while Darren Waller observed the game in street clothes. Tremble played only five snaps on offense but made the most of his limited action, which included a 15-yard reception from Bryce Young during the Panthers' seven-play, 58 yard drive in the first quarter that ended with a one-yard touchdown run from Jonathon Brooks. Tremble has logged 23-plus catches in each of the last three years and more than 230 yards in his last two seasons, but his playing time in the regular season could be limited by the presence of Waller.

metadata.title: Tommy Tremble - Faces competition with signing of Waller
metadata.description: Tremble could face competition atop the depth chart at tight end with Carolina slated to sign Darren Waller to a one-year contract, Mike Kaye of ESPN.com reports.
metadata.analysis: Regarded as a strong blocker, Tremble projects to enter his sixth season in Carolina as the team's starter, but he could end up ceding more work on obvious passing downs to Waller, who ended a one-year retirement in 2025 and delivered an impressive 24-283-6 receiving line on 34 targets over just six games with the Dolphins. Waller's receiving output was on par with Tremble's over his full 17-game slate with Carolina, as the latter contributed 27 catches for 249 yards and two touchdowns on 37 targets. The modest catch and yardage totals were all career highs for Tremble, who now appears likely to take a step back statistically in 2026 if Waller emerges as Carolina's top pass-catching tight end.

metadata.title: Tommy Tremble - Back at practice
metadata.description: Tremble (knee) returned to practice Monday, Joe Person of The Athletic reports.
metadata.analysis: Tremble sat out of Friday's practice while dealing with knee soreness, but he's back on the field to start the week. The 26-year-old is coming off a career-best 2025 season where he recorded career highs in receptions (27), yards (249) and targets (37) over 17 regular-season games. Tremble is headed into a contract year after signing a two-year extension during the 2025 offseason and is expected to once again share primary pass-catching duties at tight end with Ja'Tavion Sanders.

metadata.title: Tommy Tremble - Career year in 2025
metadata.description: Tremble caught all three of his targets for 22 yards during Saturday's 34-31 wild-card loss to the Rams.
metadata.analysis: Tremble made his presence felt during the Panthers' wild-card loss, finishing as the team's third-leading receiver while hauling in all of his targets. The fifth-year pro from Notre Dame signed a two-year extension with Carolina last offseason and quickly validated the move, setting career highs in both receptions (27) and yards (249) during the 2025 season.  With Tremble, Ja'Tavion Sanders (ankle, IR) and Mitchell Evans all under contract for 2026, Carolina's tight end room will likely remain crowded heading into next season.

metadata.title: Tommy Tremble Set for Bigger Role Going into Playoffs
metadata.description: Carolina Panthers tight end Tommy Tremble will be the team's top pass-catching tight end going into the playoffs with Ja'Tavion Sanders (ankle) on Injured Reserve. With Sanders out in the Week 18 regular-season finale against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers, Tremble caught three of his four targets for 38 yards and just his second touchdown of the year. The 25-year-old was the team's third leading receiver in the loss to Tampa. In 17 regular-season games with Carolina in 2025, Tremble caught 27 of his 37 targets for 249 yards and two scores. He'll still be more of a dart throw as a TE streamer in fantasy football playoff leagues when the Panthers take on the visiting Los Angeles Rams on Wild-Card weekend this Saturday. The Rams defense has been in the middle of the pack in terms of fantasy points allowed to opposing TEs this year, and they've allowed the eighth-fewest total yards (775) to the position.

metadata.title: Tommy Tremble finds the end zone Sunday
metadata.description: Tommy Tremble caught 3-of-4 targets for 38 yards and a touchdown in the Panthers 16-14 loss against the Buccaneers.
metadata.analysis: Tremble continued to see the field more with Ja'Tavion Sanders (ankle) out for the season. His expanded role should continue into the postseason with the Panthers hosting the Rams in the Wild Card round.

metadata.title: Tommy Tremble - Big game without Sanders
metadata.description: Tremble caught three of four targets for 38 yards and a touchdown during Saturday's 16-14 loss to the Buccaneers.
metadata.analysis: With Ja'Tavion Sanders (ankle, IR) out for the Week 18 divisional matchup, Tremble assumed more of a receiving role in the Panthers' tight end room. The Notre Dame product finished as Carolina's third-leading receiver and caught Bryce Young's first touchdown pass of the day. Tremble has appeared in all 17 of the Panthers' regular-season games this year, catching 27 of 37 targets for 249 yards and two touchdowns. Carolina now needs Atlanta to beat New Orleans on Sunday to force a three-way tie for the NFC South title. In that scenario, the Panthers would hold the tiebreaker and make the playoffs as the NFC's No. 4 seed.

metadata.title: Tommy Tremble - Logs six yards in loss
metadata.description: Tremble caught his lone target for six yards during Sunday's 27-10 loss to the Seahawks.
metadata.analysis: Tremble tied Chuba Hubbard for the third-most receiving yards on the Panthers during Sunday's loss, as the Seahawks' defense held Carolina to just 54 passing yards. Tremble, a fourth-year pro from Notre Dame, has now caught 24 of 33 targets for 211 yards and a touchdown across 16 appearances this season. With Ja'Tavion Sanders (ankle) out for the rest of the year, Tremble will likely have an expanded role as a pass catcher in the Week 18 matchup against the Buccaneers on Saturday.
